arStrings.szText: {c_important}Caltrops{/c} now deals Cold damage and {c_important}{u}Chills{/u}{/c} enemies for {c_number}{SF_16}%{/c} per second.

{c_important}Caltrops{/c} no longer Slows enemies and instead is also a {c_important}Marksman{/c} Skill that throws {c_number}[SF_33]{/c} piercing daggers over its duration, each dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_B_DAMAGE}{/c} Shadow damage. Enemies damaged by {c_important}Caltrops{/c} become {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_31]{/c} seconds.

Throw {c_number}{SF_45}{/c} smaller Caltrops that now deal Poison damage and {c_number}{dot:UPGRADE_C_POISON}{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADE_C_POISON}{/c} seconds. Enemies affected by this Poisoning are {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c}
You now have {c_number}[{SF_18} * 100|%+|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance against enemies inside your {c_important}Caltrops{/c}. Double this amount against {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} enemies.
